```sql
select cbsa_title as label, max(permits) as value from doorstep.mart_metro_year where (kind = 'metropolitan') and cbsa_title in ('Savannah, GA', 'North Port-Bradenton-Sarasota, FL') and year = 2021 group by cbsa_title order by value desc, label
```

```sql
select cbsa_title as label, max(permits) as value from doorstep.mart_metro_year where (kind = 'metropolitan') and cbsa_title in ('San Diego-Chula Vista-Carlsbad, CA', 'Richmond, VA') and year = 2014 group by cbsa_title order by value desc, label
```

```sql
select carrier as label, sum(flown) as value from turnaround.mart_carrier_month where carrier in ('EV', 'NK') and year = 2016 group by carrier order by value desc, label
```

```sql
select cbsa_title as label, max(payment_share) as value from doorstep.mart_metro_year where (kind = 'metropolitan') and cbsa_title in ('Minneapolis-St. Paul-Bloomington, MN-WI', 'Washington-Arlington-Alexandria, DC-VA-MD-WV') and year = 2016 group by cbsa_title order by value desc, label
```

```sql
select carrier as label, 100 * sum(cancelled) / sum(scheduled) as value from turnaround.mart_carrier_month where carrier in ('QX', 'MQ') and year = 2022 group by carrier order by value desc, label
```

```sql
select carrier as label, sum(arr_delay_sum) / sum(flown) as value from turnaround.mart_carrier_month where carrier in ('G4', 'AS') and year = 2019 group by carrier order by value desc, label
```

```sql
select cbsa_title as label, max(median_income) as value from doorstep.mart_metro_year where (kind = 'metropolitan') and cbsa_title in ('Peoria, IL', 'Baton Rouge, LA') and year = 2019 group by cbsa_title order by value desc, label
```

```sql
select carrier as label, sum(flown) as value from turnaround.mart_carrier_month where carrier in ('YX', 'G4') and year = 2025 group by carrier order by value desc, label
```

```sql
select carrier as label, sum(cancelled) / sum(scheduled) as value from turnaround.mart_carrier_month where carrier in ('AS', 'UA') and year = 2017 group by carrier order by value desc, label
```
